items.quote: Please send us officially certified copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and your transcript of records, together with certified German or English translations, so that they reach us by 24 August 2027.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date by which the documents must arrive at the university: 24 August 2027. No period calculation is needed; this is the deadline as printed, and it is the day the documents must be received (not merely sent), so no further adjustment for delivery or weekends applies since it is a fixed receipt deadline stated directly.

warnings: If the certified documents (originals, not scans) do not arrive by 24 August 2027, the university states it will offer the place to another applicant, so the person should send them well in advance and consider proof of delivery.
